profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a Software with experience building cloud-based applications, APIs, CRM integrations, and data processing systems.

Throughout my career, I’ve had the opportunity to work on a variety of projects using Python, AWS, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, and other cloud technologies. My work has included developing backend services, integrating enterprise platforms, and building scalable data pipelines.

I’m passionate about technology, solving complex problems, and continuously learning more about software architecture, distributed systems, and cloud computing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Computer Systems Technology Tutor - CUNY City Tech
positions.description:
Tutor in JavaScript, Java, Python, HTML, CSS, SQL, Database design, MongoDB and Express.
Worked alongside 5 other students as a peer resource for students seeking to strengthen technological skills. Aiding students working on projects and troubleshooting concerns or questions.

company.name: Research Foundation of The City University of New York

positions.title: Student Developer
positions.description:
Selected for a full stack JavaScript training program, as one of 125 students out of 400+ applicants

Learned in-demand technologies like React, Node + Express, and PostgreSQL as well as industry best practices for design, implementation, and deployment such as MVC, version control with Git/GitHub, agile
& scrum with Trello and Slack, test driven development, and CI/CD

positions.title: UX/UI Design Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated with 3 developers to gain feedback to develop cross-media projects and UI design of the website

Created a responsive logo and showcased brand identities using Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator 

Use Figma to deliver high fidelity user-interface and Apple Keynote and MOVAVI to develop and edit a promotional video

positions.title: Programming Instructor
positions.description:
Collaborated with a team of 8 instructors to teach robotics, programming, animation, AI, game design, and 3-D printing

Developed a curriculum and led a Python programming class of 6 students between the ages 10-14

Planned and implemented 3 open-house workshops focused on AR, Scratch, and Tinkercad
